name: Timeline simulator shows an error for out-of-order dates
description: Verify the simulator displays an error when events are not in chronological order.

planSteps.description: Open the app home page, click 'Simulator' in the top navigation bar, and choose 'S05' in the 'Load scenario' dropdown
Set the 'Event 2 date' field to 2026-12-01, before Event 1
Assert an error mentioning 'chronological order' is shown and no Invoice 2 total is shown
Set the 'Event 2 date' field back to 2027-01-17
